description: ⚡ ACTION: Take a screenshot of any URL — returns image URL. Chrome-based rendering, supports full-page capture, custom viewport, ad blocking, cookie banner removal. Waits for JS-heavy SPAs to load (ApiFlash)

delay.description: Wait N seconds before capture (0-10, for JS-heavy pages)

full_page.description: Capture full page scroll height (default false)

url.description: URL of the website to screenshot (e.g. "https://example.com")

name: web.screenshot.capture

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Capture Website Screenshot (ApiFlash)
